painPoints.desc: One freelancer designs in Figma, another rushes a bloated template. You end up with slow pages and leaking mobile funnels.

painPoints.title: Running Paid Ads to Weak Landing Pages
painPoints.desc: Performance marketers drive clicks, the website fails to convert, and each vendor blames the other.

painPoints.title: Monthly PDF Reports Without Pipeline Clarity
painPoints.desc: Vanity impressions hide rising acquisition costs when all you want is qualified leads and measurable revenue.

pricingSection.headline: Packages & Clear 'Starting From' Investment Guide
pricingSection.subhead: We publish realistic starting numbers to respect your time and filter poor-fit inquiries upfront.
pricingSection.whyNot8kTitle: Why don't we offer ₹8,000 website packages?
pricingSection.whyNot8kBody: An ₹8,000 website only buys a generic, slow template with zero research, zero conversion copywriting, weak security, and no accountability after launch. Your digital presence is your 24/7 storefront and sales team — cheap shortcuts end up costing far more in lost leads and rebuilds.

testimonialsSection.headline: Client Conversations (Verified Slots Only)
testimonialsSection.subhead: We never publish placeholder fake reviews from fictional customers. Verified partner testimonials appear here as projects ship.

items.q: Will you just hand us a recycled template?
items.a: Never. Every site and identity is designed around your positioning, user flows, and brand character — and you retain full ownership of your code and assets.

items.q: Will your team disappear right after launch?
items.a: No. Every fixed project includes a 30-day post-launch warranty and support window, with optional care plans or ongoing Growth Partnerships afterward.

items.q: Why is ad spend billed separately from your retainer?
items.a: For complete financial transparency. Media spend goes directly from your card/account to Meta or Google with zero markup; our fee covers strategy, creative production, and optimization.

items.q: Why do agency quotes vary so widely?
items.a: Because a static 5-page site differs vastly from a custom storefront with CRM sync, bilingual copy, and interactive motion. We list our exact cost drivers openly on our Packages page.

items.q: Why is the Brand & Digital Diagnostic required before retainers?
items.a: Running ads or rebuilding without diagnosing positioning, UX leaks, and tracking hygiene wastes capital. A 7–10 day diagnostic locks the strategy first.
